_about: Limits for the cel style, for tools/look.mjs --check: node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,coast,alpine,valley,river,desert,city,space --styles real,cel --check tools/look/cel.json (npm run check:cel runs it after tools/cel_check.mjs). The same kind of rule as in targets.json. A frame of the cel style is two flat paints to a thing, so what is held is what such a frame is: a deep sky in two bands, few colours, clean edges.
